sub_parameters.name: SrcDb
sub_parameters.description: The name of the source physical sharded database.

sub_parameters.name: SrcInstanceId
sub_parameters.description: The instance ID of the ApsaraDB RDS instance where the source physical database sharding resides.

parameters.name: InstanceDbMapping
parameters.description: The list of target instance data.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the ApsaraDB RDS instance where the target hotspot database resides.

parameters.name: Mapping
parameters.description: The list of target database data.

sub_parameters.name: DbShardColumn
sub_parameters.description: The database shard key of the associated table.

sub_parameters.name: HotDbName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the hotspot database.

sub_parameters.name: HotTableName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the hotspot sharded table. The name must use the logical table name as a prefix.

sub_parameters.name: LogicTable
sub_parameters.description: The name of the logical table for hotspot scale-out.

sub_parameters.name: TbShardColumn
sub_parameters.description: The table shard key of the associated table.

parameters.name: SupperAccountMapping
parameters.description: The list of privileged account data.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceName
sub_parameters.description: The instance ID of the ApsaraDB RDS instance that has a privileged account.

sub_parameters.name: SupperAccount
sub_parameters.description: The name of the privileged account for the ApsaraDB RDS instance.

sub_parameters.name: SupperPassword
sub_parameters.description: The password of the privileged account for the ApsaraDB RDS instance.
